## `infer` {#transform-infer}

Runs an ONNX model on the stream, in process.

Give the model as a `.onnx` file beside the config. `inputs` names the message fields that make the input tensor, in the sequence the model expects them. `outputs` names the fields the answer goes to, one per column of the model's output. The model must have one input of type `float` and kayak reads its first output.

With `shape: rows`, each message is one row and gets its answer. With `shape: window`, the transform keeps the last readings of each series in the pipeline's state bucket and forecasts from them. The answer is merged onto the reading, or sent as forecast points that `mark` can label.

kayak loads the model and runs it once on zeros when it builds the pipeline, so a wrong path, a wrong shape or an operator that kayak cannot run stops the build. To change the model, write the new file under a new name and replace the pipeline with the new `path`. If the new model does not build, the old one keeps running.

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `file` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The model file. |
| `shape` | `rows \| window` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | How the messages become the input tensor. |
| `inputs` | `list of string` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The numeric fields that make one row of the tensor, in the sequence that the model expects. |
| `outputs` | `list of string` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The fields that the answer goes to, one per output column of the model. |
| `on_missing` | `error` \| `skip` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | What to do with a message that does not have an input field or a group field. The default is `error`. With `skip`, the message passes through without an answer. |
| `provenance` | `string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | Write the model's path and sha256 under this field, on each message that has an answer. Leave it out to write nothing. |

**`model` — `type: "file"`**

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The path, relative to the directory of the config file, for example `models/pump_forecast_v1.onnx`. It must end in `.onnx` and stay in that directory. kayak reads the file when it builds the pipeline. To use a changed file, replace the pipeline or revert. |

**`shape` — `type: "rows"`**

This component takes no configuration.

**`shape` — `type: "window"`**

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `integer` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The number of readings the model takes. |
| `emit` | `merge \| points` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | What the transform does with the answer. The default is `merge`. |
| `group_by` | `list of string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The fields that identify a series, as in `reduce`. Leave it out for one series. |
| `stride` | `integer` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | Run the model after this many new readings. The default is 1, every reading. |
| `time` | `string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The field that holds the time of each reading, as an RFC 3339 string or as milliseconds since the epoch. Leave it out to use the arrival time. The forecast points count their time from it. |

**`shape`.`emit` — `type: "merge"`**

This component takes no configuration.

**`shape`.`emit` — `type: "points"`**

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mark` | `object` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | Label each message as inferred or observed. |
| `step_field` | `string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The field for the step number, from 1 to the horizon. The default is `step`. |
| `step_seconds` | `number` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The seconds between two forecast steps. With it, each point gets a time: the time of the last reading plus `step × step_seconds`. |
| `time_field` | `string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The field for the time of a point. The default is the window's `time` field, or `time` if the window has none. |

**`shape`.`emit`.`mark`**

| field | type | | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The field the label is written to, for example `origin`. |
| `inferred` | `string` | <Badge type="warning" text="required" /> | The label of a message the model made, for example `forecast`. |
| `observed` | `string` | <Badge type="info" text="optional" /> | The label of every other message that leaves the transform, for example `observed`. Leave it out to label only the forecast points. |
